sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 300. Success value 100. 5x magic damage (Wind).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Karma.
-Target: all enemies. Removes buffs.
-Target: all enemies. Activates Time Slice which reduces the time advantageous effects (buffs, special buffs, and non-removable buffs) are applied to the target by 60 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases critical hit chance by 50% for 120 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Boosts critical hit Ability Power by 50 for 120 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies Rage for 70 seconds (increases max HP, ATK, and MATK by 100%; nullifies status ailments and Cost reduction. When in effect, recovers 30% of your character's max HP, recovers 30 Cost, and removes debuffs/special debuffs when you defeat an enemy).
-Target: yourself. Applies Overcast for 60 seconds ([Special] increases max HP by 100%; nullifies special status ailments; nullifies status ailments; nullifies special debuffs; nullifies debuffs; increases all elemental defense by 60; recovers 50 Cost. After the effect ends, Time Extend activates and extends the time advantageous effects (buffs, special buffs, and non-removable buffs) are applied to yourself by 60 seconds for one time only.).
-Applies Envy Collapse (blocks max HP increase effects, increases Ability Power of damage taken by 30, increases cooldown by 30%, and increases Ability Cost consumption by 100%) to the enemy Field for 60 seconds.
Increases physical and magic Ability Power by 30 when equipped in the Main Slot.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 17000
[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Recovers 100 Cost.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 17000
All Element Defense from Unison Damage +300

Mahala, Heavenly General or Ninoyu with the same or higher Cost of the base Monster can be used as fodder.
 *Specific Monsters may also be used. See the Help section for details.
